meta.name: add-deltachat
meta.description: Add DeltaChat channel integration via @deltachat/stdio-rpc-server. Native adapter — no Chat SDK bridge. Email-based messaging with end-to-end encryption.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 通过 DeltaChat 集成加密邮件通信
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在应用中添加端到端加密的邮件聊天功能
copy.tagline_en: Integrate encrypted email messaging via DeltaChat
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add end-to-end encrypted email chat to your app

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以通过 DeltaChat 收发邮件加密消息，支持私聊和群聊，并能处理文件附件。
howto.when: 当用户通过 DeltaChat 应用向机器人发送消息时触发。首次使用需通过邀请链接或二维码添加机器人为联系人。

say.text: 帮我查一下今天的日程。
say.note: 机器人会通过 DeltaChat 回复你的日程信息。
发送图片并附带此文字，管理员可更改机器人头像。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can send and receive email-encrypted messages via DeltaChat, supporting direct messages and group chats, and can handle file attachments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a user sends a message to the bot via the DeltaChat app. First use requires adding the bot as a contact via invite link or QR code.

say_en.note: The bot will reply with your schedule via DeltaChat.
Send an image with this caption; admins can change the bot's avatar.
